title: Asiad: Sibol Identity V overcomes Indonesia, clinches quarterfinals berth
summary: Sibol Identity V kept its Asian Games campaign alive after overcoming Indonesia, 2-1, on Tuesday to secure a spot in the quarterfinals at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games.
